title: feat(setup): Setup → Configuration → Public forms lists and switches every public form
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8KF3BvUnBEoN52Vcnw6JhXg)_

Part of #36444. This PR is the card's **Settings = operations** half (ruling items 6–10 of https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/36444#issuecomment-7100386248). The **Studio = design** half (items 1–5: the designer under the object, create/delete, fields, sections, address, live preview) stays open on the card for a second PR on this branch.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — a new `@objectstack/spec/ui` export `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn` (moved verbatim from `@objectstack/metadata-core`, which re-exports it), a new Setup navigation id `nav_public_forms`, a new component id `forms:public-forms`, and new language-pack keys (the `publicFormsSetup` block and the nav label) in every shipped locale
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 设置 › 配置 新增「对外表单」：列出本环境所有对外表单（名称、所属对象、地址、开关），可一键关闭/开启、复制地址、在新标签打开。仅系统管理员可见。
- 关闭后表单地址立即打不开（与现在一致，返回「找不到表单」），表单仍留在列表里可随时重新开启。
- 已安装应用的表单，开关存为本环境的定制，不改应用本身，应用升级照常进来；重新开启且没有其它改动时，自动恢复为应用原样。
- 表单的设计（新建、删除、字段、标题）仍在 Studio，下一个 PR 做；「最近一次提交时间」本卡不做。

## What changes

- **New Setup page `forms:public-forms`** (Setup → Configuration → Public Forms, `nav_public_forms`, `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`; the page asks the same capability). One row per public form: name, the object a submission creates a record of, its address, an on/off switch, copy address, open in a new tab. No field editing, create or delete here (ruling item 7).
- **Which forms are listed** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/publicForms.ts`): read from the effective view list (`GET /meta/view`), judged by the server's own rule `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`), never a second reading of `sharing`:
  - listed = the rule would open the form with its switch on (`allowAnonymous: true` + a `publicLink`), so a switched-off form stays listed (item 8);
  - on = the rule opens it as served.
  - The name shown is the served label, else the form's title, else its first section's label, else its key.
- **Where a switch is saved** (item 9): the switch is `sharing.enabled`, saved and published at once.
  - Writable package → saved in that package.
  - Installed (read-only) app → a declared override in the app's `.custom` package (ADR-0146 D2/D3), via the same seams the in-page dashboard editor uses (`resolveDashboardEditTarget`, `ensureDashboardSaveTarget`, `overrideDraftBody`, `saveAndPublishInPackage`). The app's own package is never written, so upgrades still flow in.
  - Switching back on removes the override (the pair's row) when it held nothing but the switch, so the app's original form is served again; an override that also carries design changes keeps them, with the switch on.
  - A pending draft where the switch would save is never published or removed on its saver's behalf: the switch writes nothing and says so.
  - After an app upgrade, an override taken from an earlier version is still restored when the form is otherwise the app's current one. When it is not, it is kept with the switch on, and the page says the form stays on the app's earlier version (`basedOn`), which Studio's "Restore package original" undoes. The app's earlier document cannot be read, so a switch-only override at an old version cannot be told from a design one (review S1).
- **A form its installed app ships switched off** (address kept, `enabled: false` or `allowAnonymous: false`, or `enabled` omitted, which the stack schema parses as `false`) is withdrawn by the app's own document, and the routes never let an override re-open it (pinned in `packages/rest/src/public-form-withdrawal-effective-read.test.ts`). The page judges the app's document with the routes' own function, `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn`, against the served form switched on (slot or slug match), plus an omitted `enabled` (review M1, S2). The page reads each installed app's form's layers (`markShippedOff`, one package-list read per page load) and lists such a form as "Off (switched off by its app)" with its switch disabled, even when an override already switches it on; a switch-on writes nothing and refuses with that sentence. A form whose app's document cannot be read shows "Unknown", never On (N5).
- **`anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn` moves into `@objectstack/spec/ui`** (`anonymous-form-intake.ts`, beside the candidates half), verbatim: it is a pure judgement of the bodies it is handed. `@objectstack/metadata-core` re-exports the same binding, so the routes' import is unchanged, and its identity test now pins this name with the others (one copy, not a twin). Spec `api-surface` and `export-origins` regenerated (1 added).
- **Permission:** the page asks `manage_platform_settings` (its Setup entry's); the switches also ask `manage_metadata`, the capability the server checks on every write they make. Without it the forms are listed, the switches are disabled, and a sentence says why. A refused switch is told in business words (403 → no permission; anything else → the server refused, try again), and so is a failed list read; the server's own message goes to the console log only (review N1, N3, N6).
- **Switched-off behaviour (F3 = A):** unchanged, `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND`. The routes already honour an override that withdraws a base's form (`anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn`), so no route, spec key, error code or stored-key change was needed: Metadata-protocol stays `none`. The new spec export (the moved withdrawal judgement), the new navigation id, component id and language keys are the widening the Clause-② line declares.
- Business wording only (item 10): new `publicFormsSetup` block in all 11 console locales; nav label in all 11 platform-object locales (zh-CN 「对外表单」).
- Access restrictions (password, expiry, domains) are exposed on neither surface, per the ruling.
- **Not built: "last submission time".** A submission is an ordinary record of the form's object and records no form, so there is nothing to read (stated in the ruling).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/publicForms.test.ts` (26 cases): the listing rule (on, off-but-listed, internal forms, non-form views, naming); writable-package save; installed app off → override in `.custom` with its `overrides` declaration and nothing in the app; reading the base when the listed pair does not hold the form; on with a switch-only override → restore (reset at the pair, no save); on with a design override → kept, switch on, `basedOn` unchanged; pending draft → nothing written (both the client-side check and the server's `409 METADATA_CONFLICT`); refusals (package not listed, unreadable form, no version to declare); a base shipped off, both `enabled: false` and absent `enabled`, refused with nothing written, with and without an override already on, and listed as not on (`markShippedOff`); an app that ships `allowAnonymous: false` under an override that opens it, refused and listed as not on; an unreadable app document → `unknown`, not on; an override switch-only at `basedOn: 2.0.0` against a changed 3.0.0 base → `{ kind: 'earlier-version', basedOn: '2.0.0' }`, kept; the same against an unchanged base → restored. Ablations: dropping the refusal, the listing mark, the earlier-version answer, the routes' withdrawal rule, or the unknown mark, or reading an absent switch as on, each turns cases red.
- `PublicFormsSetupPage.test.tsx` (8 cases, rendered): the Setup capability gate; without `manage_metadata` the switches are disabled with the sentence; a shipped-off form shows "switched off by its app" with a disabled switch (both spellings); the pending-draft toast leaves the row as it was; a 403 and a 500 are told by key, with no server text; a failed list read shows the business sentence without the server text; an unreadable app document shows "Unknown", not On. Ablations of the metadata gate, the shipped-off mark and the business-word refusal each turn a case red.
- `PublicFormsSetupPage.navContribution.test.tsx` (3 cases): the ref is registered by the production registration, addresses `component/forms/public-forms`, and mounts through the component route.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/anonymous-form-intake.test.ts`: the identity case now includes `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn` (metadata-core's export is the spec binding); the package's 1,057 tests pass, and so does `packages/rest/src/public-form-withdrawal-effective-read.test.ts`.
- `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts`: Setup nav count 34 → 35, plus `nav_public_forms` is served to a `manage_platform_settings` holder. Red without the fix: against a platform-objects build without the nav entry it fails `expected [...] to have a length of 35 but got 34`.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/zh-hant-generated.test.ts`: passes with `src/locales/zh-Hant.ts` regenerated from zh (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant`).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts`: the new page's `useMetadata().objects` read is classified `off` (Setup, not an app object-list open).

## Acceptance notes

Live run on `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) + console dev server, as the seeded admin. `com.example.crm` lists as not writable, so this exercised the installed-app (customization) path:

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Open Setup → Configuration → Public Forms | 1 row, "Contact us", Lead, `…/f/contact-us`, On |
| Switch off | toast; row Off; `GET /api/v1/forms/contact-us` → `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND`; `/f/contact-us` shows "Page not found" |
| Reload the page | still listed, still Off |
| Switch on | `GET /api/v1/forms/contact-us` → 200; the form renders and takes input again |
| Layers after switching on | `effective._packageId = com.example.crm`, no override left in `com.example.crm.custom` (restored to the app original) |

Screenshots (live run, 2× scale) are in the project's shared files under `issue-36444/`; they cannot be uploaded to GitHub from the cloud seat:
- `01-public-forms-on.png`: the page with the Setup sidebar entry, form On.
- `02-public-forms-off.png`: after switching off (toast, Off).
- `03-anon-form-off.png`: the anonymous address while off.
- `04-public-forms-back-on.png`, `05-anon-form-on.png`: switched back on, the form takes input again.

The Studio designer screenshot comes with the second PR.

Premise finding for the Studio half: the existing Developer → Public Forms entry (`nav_public_forms` in `studio.app.ts`, `developer:public-forms`) is served only where a host loads `@objectstack/studio`; no example and no CLI default loads it, so the console's own Studio has no public-forms entry today. The second PR places the designer under the object in the console's Studio, within the seven-tab Data pillar (objectui#12450).

Overlap: merges cleanly with `main`, #36629 and #36525. #34223 (draft since 11-19) also bumps the same Setup nav count line in the CLI pin test; whichever lands second takes the other's count.

## Verification

Head `2a859fb0a4` (review round 2: S2, N5, N6; round 1 at `d91c73bcad`; `main` merged in earlier as `33a41ea1b0`, no rebase).

- The derived gate union (`dispatch-gates --commands`, now 94 commands with the spec and metadata-core paths): 94/94 exit 0 on `2a859fb0a4`.
- CI on `2a859fb0a4`: all workflows completed (Spec Liveness Check included), 59 checks success, 10 skipped (opt-in, queue and schedule gates), 0 failure.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (src + tests): exit 0. eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.
- Locale keys in all 11 console locales; zh-Hant regenerated from zh (`gen:zh-hant`).
- Earlier heads: `a502b8c57` had two reds, fixed in `d3b3b09d3` (`check:spec-symbols` refused a local type `Doc`, renamed `FormDoc`; the `openPathObjectReaders-12811` census, classified). `d3b3b09d3` had one red, Test UI (10/16), the stale zh-Hant locale, fixed in `5c7d009426`. `8902d697ee` and `d91c73bcad` were all green.
- Locally `peopleAssignments.navContribution.test.tsx` ("Position holders" heading) fails on `main` as well; CI runs it green. Not touched here.
